===By car===
Coonabarabran is at the very end of B56, and is located on the Newell Highway. The town is about a two hour drive from Dubbo north via the A39 Newell Highway and is a 1.5-hour drive south from [[Narrabri]] via the A39 Newell Highway.
===By plane===
Though {{marker|type=go|name=Coonabarabran Airport|wikidata=Q17535}} ({{IATA|COJ}}) exists, there are no regularly scheduled flights to the airport. The nearest airports with regular services are in [[Dubbo]] to the southwest or [[Tamworth (New South Wales)|Tamworth]] to the east.
